scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 Super Time Patroller Uniform and Time Ring of Memories evidence reconciliation
verification_policy: Keep the costume and ring as separate inventory identities. Record the documented unlock sequence and post-launch acquisition issue without inventing an exact mission requirement or merging the ring into the official six costume/accessory count.

records.name: Super Time Patroller Uniform
records.identity: Community catalogue and Chapter 4 unlock coverage identify this as a CAC costume associated with the final DLC period.
records.acquisition: Reported as an unlock associated with completing the final Chapter 4 content; exact mission-level trigger remains unresolved.
records.known_issue: Multiple community guides specifically warn that the Offline Lobby may be required when the reward does not appear correctly.

records.name: Time Ring of Memories
records.identity: Separate reward/equipment identity from the Super Time Patroller Uniform.
records.acquisition: Reported by Chapter 4 unlock guides as part of the final-content unlock sequence; exact mission-level trigger remains unresolved.
records.known_issue: Community unlock guides report cases where the ring and/or uniform failed to appear and recommend using an Offline Lobby.
records.official_six_costume_count: not counted as one of the six Chapter 4 costumes/accessories unless item-level evidence establishes that category relationship

evidence_reconciliation.official_chapter_4_category_rule: Bandai's Chapter 4 announcement establishes the DLC feature set, but does not by itself establish an item-level unlock condition for either record.
evidence_reconciliation.unlock_guide_consensus: Two independent secondary unlock-guide results explicitly cover the Super Time Patroller Suit and Time Ring of Memories; one specifically instructs players having trouble to use the Offline Lobby.
evidence_reconciliation.catalogue_identity: The Super Time Patroller Uniform is independently catalogued as Chapter 4-era CAC clothing.
evidence_reconciliation.reward_issue: The existence of an acquisition/reward-delivery issue is recorded as community troubleshooting evidence, not as proof of a universal bug state or of a specific server-side cause.

important_nonclaims: Do not claim an exact Chapter 4 story mission number without item-level evidence.
Do not merge Time Ring of Memories with the Super Time Patroller Uniform.
Do not count the ring as one of the official six costumes/accessories merely because guides present it alongside the uniform.
Do not infer a drop rate or RNG percentage from unlock-guide videos.
Do not assign either reward to a Normal versus Ultimate Finish condition without direct evidence.
Do not treat Offline Lobby troubleshooting as proof that online acquisition is universally impossible.
research_targets: Identify the exact story/Extra Mission record that grants the uniform.
Identify the exact record that grants Time Ring of Memories and whether it is guaranteed or conditional.
Determine whether the two rewards are granted together, separately, or through different completion checkpoints.
Reconcile the Super Time Patroller Uniform against the six-item Chapter 4 costume/accessory inventory.
Investigate the reported reward-delivery issue against official patch notes or reproducible current-version testing.
Locate item-level identifiers if reliable inventory data becomes available.
